title: Sanad Found a TREASURE Under the Tree! 💰😱 #shorts
description:
Sanad goes to plant a little tree… but his shovel hits something shiny! ⛏️✨
A treasure chest full of gold coins and gems! 💰💎
Then Mirai has a clever idea: take it to the gold shop and trade it for money! 🏪💵
And in the end… they plant the little tree together 🌱

💡 Lesson: share the good news with friends — and keep planting!
